title: Hitler to Cookie Monster: how?
description:
Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Cookie Monster: Mussolini's foreign minister Ciano, Lord Halifax, Churchill, Queen Elizabeth II and Michelle Obama.

Adolf Hitler → Galeazzo Ciano → E. F. L. Wood, 1st Earl of Halifax → Winston Churchill → Elizabeth II → Michelle Obama → Cookie Monster

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Galeazzo Ciano: In 1940, Hitler met Mussolini's foreign minister, Galeazzo Ciano, in Vienna.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Teleki_%26_Hitler_Tripartite-pact.jpg
2. Galeazzo Ciano → Lord Halifax: In 1939, Ciano shared an opera box in Rome with Britain's Lord Halifax.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mussolini_and_Chamberlain_in_Rome_1939.jpg
3. Lord Halifax → Winston Churchill: In 1938, Halifax walked through London beside Winston Churchill.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:0929_fc-churchill-halifax.jpg
4. Winston Churchill → Queen Elizabeth II: In 1953, Churchill was prime minister to the young Queen Elizabeth.
   Photo by Official photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Churchill_queen_Elizabeth_1953.jpg
5. Queen Elizabeth II → Michelle Obama: In 2016, the Queen hosted Barack and Michelle Obama at Windsor Castle.
   Photo by Lawrence Jackson, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama%27s_trip_to_the_United_Kingdom_April_2016_(5).jpg
6. Michelle Obama → Cookie Monster: And in 2014, Michelle Obama posed for a photo with Cookie Monster.
   Photo, Public domain (White House photo): https://catalog.archives.gov/id/441119826

Research notes: The obvious exit, Lord Halifax's 1937 visit to Hitler's Berghof, survives only in non-free press copies, so Hitler leaves through Mussolini's foreign minister Ciano, who stood beside Halifax at the Rome opera in 1939.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: In May 1940 Lord Halifax could have become Britain's prime minister, but he stepped aside and the job went to Winston Churchill.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
